label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679) - Article 17: Right to erasure (‘right to be forgotten’)
2. Where the controller has made the personal data public and is obliged pursuant to paragraph 1 to erase the personal data, the controller, taking account of available technology and the cost of implementation, shall take reasonable steps, including technical measures, to inform controllers which are processing the personal data that the data subject has requested the erasure by such controllers of any links to, or copy or replication of, those personal data.
raw_output: When a customer requests their personal data to be deleted, businesses that handle public personal data must notify other companies processing that data to remove links or copies of the information. This applies during data management steps like handling a deletion request or updating customer records.
enrichment: When a customer requests their personal data to be deleted, businesses that handle public personal data must notify other companies processing that data to remove links or copies of the information.
